findings.title: A monotonic sequence/revision reducer can still roll visible market time backward
findings.promotion_rule: Replay current bounded quote traces through the naive reducer and reproduce material visible-time rollback across both tickers and at least two connection phases.

findings.title: Backward-time updates may also overwrite last-price fields
findings.promotion_rule: Promote only when an accepted backward-time payload contains a changed finite ltp or lts value.

findings.title: Repeated subscription snapshots can reinitialize client state
findings.promotion_rule: Confirm init=1 snapshots after the repeated identical subscription; classify as a defect candidate only if they replace a newer client state with older sequence, revision, market time or price.

findings.title: The quote payload lacks explicit provenance for contradictory time domains
findings.promotion_rule: Confirm material backward-time updates without any allowlisted provenance field. This remains a system-contract signal, not proof of the upstream source.

claim_boundary: This audit evaluates deterministic client-state consequences of bounded public demo quote messages. It does not identify an upstream venue, entitlement source, production account behavior, order-execution impact, legal impact or server-side resource leak.
